(defn- spawn-candidate
  "Spawn a candidate world (c/planet-candidate + c/position) at `pos`.
   Returns [world eid]."
  [world pos]
  (let [[w eid] (ecs/spawn world)]
    [(ecs/put-components w eid {c/planet-candidate {:planet-id eid}
                                c/position         pos})
     eid]))
